description: Explicit nontrivial logical operators of the merged codes of algebraic fibre surgery (instances I-III, lifts 9, 15, 33). Supports are zero-based qubit indices in the ordering of algebraic_qec.examples.surgery_instances (data qubits first, then auxiliary qubits). Each support is checked by verify_instances.py; a support of weight w gives the upper bound w on that sector's distance.
